About

Source: vignettes/about.Rmd
about.Rmd

The MicrobiomeR package was developed at the University of Mississippi Medical Center in Dr. Eric Vallender’s lab by Rob Gilmore and Shaurita Hutchins.

This package is associated with a microbiome study (article to be submitted soon), which was conducted by Ph.D. candidate, Xiao Zhang.
